title: Product Engineer
location: PARIS OFFICE or REMOTE FROM FRANCE
description: Who We Are Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster. Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research. Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026. 🎯 The Role We are looking for a Product Engineer with a strong product mindset to join our engineering team and contribute to the development of our AI-powered platform. At Inato, being a Product Engineer means more than building features. It means understanding the problems we solve, the needs of our users, and the business challenges behind our decisions. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with a multidisciplinary team composed of a Product Lead, AI Engineers, and other Product Engineers. You will take ownership of features throughout their lifecycle, from understanding the problem and challenging assumptions to designing, implementing, and evaluating solutions. We believe that great products are built through a combination of technical excellence, product thinking, curiosity, and collaboration. How is this opportunity different? Meaningful impact: Contribute to making clinical trials more accessible and inclusive, with a tangible impact on patients' lives. Product-driven culture: Work on an established SaaS platform alongside a product team that prioritizes business and user impact over the number of features delivered. Intellectual challenges: Solve complex product, business, and engineering problems in an industry where AI plays an increasingly central role. Engineering excellence: Join a team of 15 engineers with a strong culture of technical quality, modern technologies, and continuous improvement. Continuous growth: Develop your technical and product expertise through ownership, learning, initiative, and constructive feedback. Collaborative culture: Work alongside passionate colleagues who value knowledge sharing, mutual support, diverse perspectives, and collective success. Typical projects you could be working on Integrating Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to help research sites assess patients against clinical trial eligibility criteria. Building a centralized experience for research site networks, allowing them to apply to trials and assess patients across multiple sites. Collaborating with AI Engineers to integrate AI-powered capabilities into reliable, intuitive, and valuable product experiences. 🚀 Responsibilities Build features from beginning to end: discovery, design, implementation, deployment, and support. Understand user needs and business objectives to challenge assumptions and contribute to product decisions. Balance technical complexity, product value, and long-term maintainability. Leverage AI tools to improve your engineering workflows while maintaining high standards of quality, security, and reliability. Continuously improve our engineering practices, processes, and tools. Learn from your teammates and share your knowledge internally and externally. 🔎 What We Are Looking For Product & Business Mindset You are genuinely interested in understanding why you are building something, not just how to build it. You take a step back, ask relevant questions, and consider the broader business and user impact of your work. You enjoy collaborating with Product Managers, challenging ideas constructively, and finding pragmatic solutions to complex problems. Technical Foundations You have 2+ years of professional experience building and maintaining web products within an engineering team, with concrete achievements you can talk about . You have solid software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern web technologies. Ideally, you have a full-stack background with a stronger interest in back-end engineering and software architecture. If your background is primarily front-end, we also welcome applications from engineers who have started exploring back-end development or are genuinely motivated to deepen their expertise in this area. You actively explore and use AI-powered development tools, with a critical understanding of their capabilities and limitations. Growth & Mindset You are intellectually curious, analytical, and able to quickly grasp new concepts. You actively seek opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and expand your responsibilities. Your career reflects a willingness to progress, explore new areas, and continuously improve your skills. You value constructive feedback, collaboration, and collective success. Professional Experience You have experience working on a SaaS product, ideally within a growing startup or scaleup, where you have experienced evolving product needs, technical challenges, and organizational growth. You can communicate clearly in both written and spoken English and French. 💻 Our Technical Environment Explore our current technology stack and the tools we use to build and scale our product on StackShare . We don't expect you to already master every technology in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn. ⭐ Bonus Experience with functional programming, particularly in TypeScript.
